lines.text: Echo answers your customers from your help center and past conversations, and knows when to bring in a person.
Atlas turns customer needs into a plan your team can review.
Scribe works out the details before coding begins.
Forge writes the change, runs the tests, and opens a pull request.
Lens looks for risks and missing tests.
Beacon gets your next customer follow-up ready.
And Mira turns customer signals into launch messaging.
They share one history with your team, and they ask before they act.
Need a different job done? Build your own.
